name: Celebrity Family Feud
description: Celebrity Family Feud pits celebrities and their families against each other in a contest to name the most popular responses to survey-type questions posed to 100 people.

videos.title: Anthony Anderson vs. Toni Braxton; Monica Potter vs. Curtis Stone
videos.overview: The series premiere of Celebrity Family Feud features actor Anthony Anderson’s (black-ish) family vs. 7-time Grammy Award-winning artist Toni Braxton and her sisters; and in a separate game, family members from Australian celebrity chef Curtis Stone and actress Monica Potter spar off against each other to win money for a charity of their choice.

videos.title: NFL AFC vs NFC and Dancing with the Stars vs The Bachelor
videos.overview: Celebrity Family Feud will feature players from the National Football League Players Association (NFLPA), and in a separate game, professional dancers from Dancing With the Stars and popular participants from the romantic reality shows The Bachelor and The Bachelorette will spar off against each other to win money for a charity of their choice.

videos.title: Dr. Phil McGraw vs. Garry & Penny Marshall and Kevin McHale vs. Fred Willard
videos.overview: The family of mental health professional and host of the Dr. Phil talk show, Dr. Phil McGraw, will spar against members from the family of television/film legends Penny Marshall and Garry Marshall. In a separate game, family members of actor/singer Kevin McHale (Glee) will team up against the family of iconic comedic actor Fred Willard.

videos.title: Cheryl Hines vs. Niecy Nash and "Duck Dynasty" vs. Katy Mixon
videos.overview: The celebrity families competing to win cash for their charities feature the families from award-winning actress/comedienne Niecy Nash vs. actress Cheryl Hines; and in a separate game, family members from actress Katy Mixon vs. The Robertson’s from A&E’s Duck Dynasty.

videos.title: Rob Gronkowski vs. Holly Robinson Peete and Bill Engvall vs. Keke Palmer
videos.overview: The family of Super Bowl-winning New England Patriots Rob Gronkowski will team up against the family of actress Holly Robinson-Peete. In a separate game, family members of award-winning actress Keke Palmer will spar against the family of actor/comedian Bill Engvall.

videos.title: Joey Lawrence vs. Mario Lopez and Ed Asner vs. Vicki Lawrence
videos.overview: The family of actor/TV host Mario Lopez will team up against the family of actor/producer Joey Lawrence. In a separate game, family members of 7-Time Emmy Award-winning actor Ed Asner will spar against the family of award-winning comedienne Vicki Lawrence.

videos.title: Lance Bass vs Kellie Pickler
videos.overview: The celebrity families competing to win cash for their charities feature the families from award-winning country music recording artist Kellie Pickler; and Lance Bass, member of the multi-platinum pop boy band *NSYNC. In a separate game, family members from NeNe Leakes, star of ABC's "To Tell the Truth," will compete against the family of actor Ernie Hudson.

videos.title: AFC Defense vs NFC Offense and AFC Offense vs NFC Defense
videos.overview: Football teams from the AFC and NFC face off for a chance to win up to $25,000 to donate to a charity of their choice.

videos.title: Sugar Ray Leonard vs Snoop Dogg and Ken Jeong vs Tisha Campbell Martin
videos.overview: Celebrity battles include Sugar Ray Leonard vs. rapper Snoop Dogg, and actor Ken Jeong and actress Tisha Campbell-Martin from the ABC comedy "Dr. Ken" square off.

videos.title: Professional Boxers Showdown and Joely Fisher vs Tony Hawk
videos.overview: Champion boxers and managers try to score a knockout when they compete against each other to win cash for their charities. In a separate game, family members of actress Joely Fisher compete against the family of professional skateboarder and entrepreneur Tony Hawk.

videos.title: The Band Perry vs Giuliana Rancic and Melissa Joan Hart vs Paul Sorvino
videos.overview: Country Music superstars The Band Perry compete against the family of host and author Giuliana Rancic to win cash for their charities. In a separate game, family members of actress Melissa Joan Hart square off against the family of legendary actor Paul Sorvino.

videos.title: Bachelors vs Bachelorettes and Indy Car Drivers vs Sports Illustrated Models
videos.overview: Contestants from "The Bachelor" and "The Bachelorette" franchises compete to win cash for their charities. In a separate game, Sports Illustrated supermodels square off against Verizon IndyCar drivers.

videos.title: Paula Deen vs Carson Kressley and Rico Rodriguez vs Jaleel White
videos.overview: The celebrity families competing to win cash for their charities feature celebrity chef and cooking show TV host Paula Deen and Emmy-winning TV star and celebrity stylist Carson Kressley. In a separate game, family members of Modern Family star Rico Rodriguez will compete against the family of actor Jaleel White.

videos.title: Tommy Davidson vs Kristi Yamaguchi and Dave Foley vs Jalen Rose
videos.overview: The celebrity families competing to win cash for their charities feature the families of stand-up comedian and actor Tommy Davidson and Olympic figure skating gold medalist Kristi Yamaguchi. In a separate game, ESPN analyst and former NBA star Jalen Rose heads up a team of sports players and journalists competing against the family of comedian and actor Dave Foley.

videos.title: Gus Kenworthy vs Sheryl Underwood and David Chokachi vs Alan Thicke
videos.overview: The celebrity families competing to win cash for their charities feature the family of Olympic silver medalist and free skiing champion Gus Kenworthy facing off against the family of "The Talk" co-host Sheryl Underwood. In a separate game, the family of actor David Chokachi takes on the family of actor Alan Thicke.

videos.title: Garrett Morris vs Alfonso Ribiero and Todd Chrisley vs Sara Evans

In a separate game, the family of Todd Chrisley, star and executive producer of "Chrisley Knows Best," competes against the family of Grammy-nominated and multi-platinum country singer Sara Evans.

The next game of the night features famous twin athletes and top divas Nikki and Brie Bella, stars of “Total Bellas,” opposing a team of champion mixed martial arts (MMA) fighters.
